FAQs
What does it mean to be Uxcel Certified?
A Uxcel certification confirms that you passed a rigorous, skills-based assessment measuring real proficiency, not just course completion. Every exam is scored against a defined competency benchmark set by industry practitioners, so the credential reflects demonstrated ability in the subject, not time spent studying.
Does this certification expire?
Yes. Uxcel certifications are valid for 3 years from the date they are earned. After that, you can renew at a reduced rate to keep the credential active. The expiration exists for a reason: design standards and tools evolve, and renewal ensures every certified professional stays current with the field.
How is this certification earned?
Each certification is a timed, single-attempt exam drawn from a large question pool, so no two tests are identical. To pass, you must meet or exceed the score threshold defined for that certification. This structure keeps the credential meaningful and difficult to game, which is what makes it worth displaying.
How can employers verify this credential?
This page is the verification. Every certification is issued by Uxcel with a unique, shareable URL, so recruiters and hiring managers can confirm authenticity in one click. There is nothing to request or cross-check elsewhere: if it is on this page, it is real.
How do I earn a Uxcel certification?
Uxcel offers certifications across UX, product, and design specialities, from foundational skills to advanced professional tracks. You can browse the full lineup and get certified in the areas that matter to your career. Uxcel Pro members get 30% off every certification. Learn more
